summary: Backend testing of PromoSmart AI completed. 22/22 pytest cases passed (100%). Covered: admin login, registration (success + duplicate), products list/filter (category=Footwear, brand=Nike, total >=100), create-product auth requirement and CRUD, categories (5+), brands (7+), promotions list/active filter (20+), create-promotion auth, cart creation/add/remove/invalid product, threshold promotion auto-calculation (subtotal>4000 invariant subtotal-discount==total), Gemini 3 Flash AI recommendation endpoint (returned recommended_products + explanation), analytics overview with categories/brands/promotion_types.

minor.issue: Endpoints only check for valid JWT (get_current_user) but do NOT enforce admin role. Any authenticated user can create/update/delete products and promotions.
No authentication on cart endpoints — any caller can read/modify any user's cart by knowing the user_id. Consider tying to current_user.
Accepts role field from request body unchecked, allowing self-registration as admin (role='admin'). Should ignore client-supplied role or restrict to 'user'.
Behavior overwrites quantity for existing items instead of incrementing; semantics may surprise frontend (works as designed but worth confirming).

action_items: Add admin-role check (current_user['role']=='admin') for product/promotion/category/brand mutation endpoints.
Add auth check on cart endpoints to prevent IDOR (one user reading/modifying another user's cart).
Sanitize role on /api/auth/register so users cannot self-elevate to admin.
Decide on add-to-cart semantics: increment vs overwrite quantity (currently overwrites).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: protected endpoints rely only on JWT presence, not role. get_current_user does not verify role==admin.
auth/register accepts role from payload — security risk for privilege escalation.
Cart endpoints are unauthenticated; user_id is a path param trusted from caller.
JWT_SECRET in .env is a placeholder ('your-secret-key-change-in-production-12345') — must be rotated for production.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager.
promotion_engine and ai_service not lint-checked here but no runtime errors observed during 22 tests including Gemini call.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing 100 products, 20 promotions, 5 categories, 7 brands. TEST_-prefixed products/promotions are cleaned up in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs returning 2xx. Gemini AI integration verified via /api/recommendations/analyze and works within ~10-15s. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable; runs in <20s. Frontend not tested per request. Main security concerns logged as action items (role enforcement, cart auth, register role sanitization).
